svg.title: Prefix, coarse and fine interleaving
svg.desc: Three ways to order music and text tokens in one sequence. Prefix: the whole clip, then the text; Qwen2-Audio and LLark work this way. Coarse interleaving: long chunks in time order; Qwen2.5-Omni cuts video and audio into 2-second chunks and ties positions to time with TMRoPE. Fine interleaving: a few tokens of each stream at a time; CosyVoice 2 alternates 5 text and 15 speech tokens, GLM-4-Voice 13 text and 26 speech tokens, and Spirit LM switches at word boundaries.
svg.text: a few tokens at a time
Spirit LM: switches at word boundaries
